status: Complete background-qualified fixture measurements; host isolation unproven
limitations: Both quiet_host_proven and host_quiet_claim are false. Unpaused VMs share host CPUs.
Body wall time is end-to-end loopback fixture behavior. External Python generation, masking, validation and network progress affect it; Titan process CPU excludes peer CPU.
Caps can leave either paired lane below 250 ms. Such pairs do not support robust performance comparisons.
Fairness samples are finite pooled sampler-return intervals. One-ms timer samples are interarrival intervals, not deadline lateness.
Sampling arrays are bounded; truncation is insufficient. Submission marker does not identify TCP/TLS/WebSocket buffer occupancy.
Uninstrumented allocation fields are placeholders and provide no requested-allocation ledger or peak-heap evidence.
No generic queue bound, zero-copy, zero-retention, isolated codec CPU or cross-platform performance claim.
